sources.title: README.md · nvidia/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4 at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The NVIDIA Qwen3-8B FP4 model is the quantized version of Alibaba's Qwen3-8B model, which is an auto-regressive language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture. For more information, please check here. The NVIDIA Qwen3-8B FP4 model is quantized with TensorRT Model Optimizer. This model is ready for commercial/non-commercial use.
